units.source_text: 她们本来是七个人，打九月二日起就剩下四个了。

en.t: There had originally been seven of them, but from September second only four were left.

units.source_text: 因为只在夏季来帮忙的姑娘们回家去了。

en.t: That was because the girls who came to help only during the summer had gone home.

units.source_text: 旅馆主人的侄女刚从女校毕业，正准备上助产士学校。

en.t: The innkeeper's niece had just graduated from girls' school and was preparing to enter a midwifery school.

units.source_text: 她是个近视眼，名叫高子，

en.t: She was nearsighted, and her name was Takako,

units.source_text: 从十四岁到十七岁上当了这家旅馆的女佣，

en.t: and from the age of fourteen to seventeen she had worked as a maid at this inn,

units.source_text: 这里离她家很近，每逢生意兴隆，总是立即把她唤来帮忙。

en.t: Since it was very close to her home, whenever business was good they would immediately call her over to help.

units.source_text: 阿谷熟悉旅馆的情况，很是能干，深受老板娘的垂青，

en.t: Otani knew the inn well, was very capable, and was much favored by the landlady,

units.source_text: 据说旅馆赏钱给她添置了全套嫁妆。

en.t: and it was said that the inn had rewarded her by providing a complete set of bridal furnishings.

units.source_text: 阿谷和农村姑娘阿时——阿时今早就来玩了——赶上下了一场暴风雨。

en.t: Otani and the village girl Otoki, who had come to visit that morning, were caught in a violent storm.
